elements_selected.content: Add SPL code blocks to existing demo-vault files and create new demo files to exercise the reasoning pipeline. Create: 1) demo-vault/decisions/Redis vs Memcached.md with SPL facts and defeasible rule for decided-use-redis, 2) demo-vault/audits/License Audit.md with a defeater for decided-use-redis, 3) demo-vault/processes/Deployment Checklist.md with a rule requiring verified-load-test and verified-security-audit for ready-for-production, 4) demo-vault/theories/caching.spl standalone SPL file. Files should use wikilinks AND SPL blocks to demonstrate cross-referencing. Use the literal naming conventions from SPEC-005 §3.3.
